description: Faithful to prod @atom63/ui item: the Item container has variant (default/outline/muted) + size (default/sm/xs); ItemMedia has its own variant (default/icon/image). The DS recipe reads these off data-variant / data-size, and styles a row with aria-current or data-selected as current or selected. ItemGroup takes variant (default/inset): inset is a rounded card with hairline dividers, the grouped settings list. ItemGroup surface (card/muted, data-surface) fills an inset group: card (the default) is the panel fill for a grey page, muted is the grey fill for a white page. A selected or current row follows tone (neutral/accent, data-tone): neutral is the muted fill with primary text, accent is the opt-in primary wash with accent text.

crossRenderer.intent: Group related rows on one inset surface with a divider between rows, as in a grouped settings list.

react: ItemGroup variant="inset" draws the group; a heading above it and a note below it belong to the page.
ItemGroup surface="muted" fills the inset group with the muted grey, for a white page (bg-card); the default card fill sits on the grey page.
A row that navigates is an Item rendered as a link, with its value in bold and a chevron in ItemActions.

In the phone form factor an inset group's default and sm rows are at least 52px tall (--a63-inset-row-min-size) and the card has the 2xl corner (--a63-inset-group-radius); elsewhere they keep the control-height floor and --radius-lg.
swiftUI: AtomListSection draws the group inside a ScrollView and takes an optional header and footer; inside a List or Form, the native Section draws it.
AtomListSection(surface: .muted) fills the section with surfaceMuted for a surfacePanel page; the default .card fill sits on surfacePage.
AtomListSection rows are at least 52pt tall, scaled with Dynamic Type, and the section has an 18pt continuous corner.
AtomValueRow(_:value:emphasizesValue:showsDisclosure:) is the label, value and chevron row.

Rows pad themselves with atomListRowInsets() inside their tap area, so a NavigationLink or Button row is tappable edge to edge; Atom63 rows do it already, and a custom row takes the modifier inside its label.
